literature.quote: As it could be expected, the cumulative number of close approaches increases approximately as a quadratic function of geocentric distance (Fig. 3). However, the count of bodies in smaller geocentric distances is higher than quadratic dependance resulting purely from Keplerian motion. It is due to the Earth's gravity, although the effect is minor
